```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(anndataR)
```

```{r}
file.info("5_carpall_annotated.h5ad")$size / 1e9  # size in GB
```


```{r}
carpall <- anndataR::read_h5ad("5_carpall_annotated.h5ad", as = "Seurat")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(carpall, group.by = "broad_labels")
```

```{r}
Idents(carpall) <- "Timepoint_bin"
early <- subset(carpall, idents = "Early")
late <- subset(carpall, idents = "Late")
rm(carpall)
table(early$broad_labels)
table(late$broad_labels)
```

```{r}
LayerData(late, assay = "RNA", layer = "data") <-
  LayerData(late, assay = "RNA", layer = "logcounts")

LayerData(early, assay = "RNA", layer = "data") <-
  LayerData(early, assay = "RNA", layer = "logcounts")

Layers(late[["RNA"]])  # should now include "data"
```

```{r}
late.chat <- createCellChat(late, group.by = "broad_labels", assay = "RNA")
early.chat <- createCellChat(early, group.by = "broad_labels", assay = "RNA")
```

```{r}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human # use CellChatDB.mouse if running on mouse data
showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)
```
```{r}
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB)
```

```{r}
early.chat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
late.chat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
```
```{r}
early.chat <- subsetData(early.chat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
late.chat <- subsetData(late.chat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
```
```{r}
early.chat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(early.chat)
early.chat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(early.chat)
late.chat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(late.chat)
late.chat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(late.chat)
```

```{r}
early.chat <- subsetData(early.chat)
late.chat <- subsetData(late.chat)
```

```{r}
early.chat <- computeCommunProb(early.chat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1, population.size = F)
late.chat <- computeCommunProb(late.chat, type = "truncatedMean", trim=0.1, population.size = F)
```
```{r}
early.chat <- filterCommunication(early.chat, min.cells = 10, min.samples=1)
late.chat <- filterCommunication(late.chat, min.cells = 10, min.samples=1)
```
```{r}
early.chat <- computeCommunProbPathway(early.chat)
late.chat <- computeCommunProbPathway(late.chat)
```
```{r}
early.chat <- aggregateNet(early.chat)
late.chat <- aggregateNet(late.chat)
```
```{r}
options(future.seed = TRUE)
early.chat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(early.chat, slot.name = "netP")
late.chat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(late.chat, slot.name = "netP")
```
```{r}
saveRDS(early.chat, file = "early.cellchat.rds")
saveRDS(late.chat, file = "late.cellchat.rds")
```

```{r}
object.list <- list(AML= AML.chat, HC = HC.chat)
chat_object <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
```

```{r}
netVisual_diffInteraction(chat_object, comparison = c(1,2), vertex.size.max = 10, edge.width.max = 1,label.edge = F)
```

```{r}
p1 <- compareInteractions(chat_object, show.legend = F, group = c("AML", "HC"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("mediumseagreen", "darkorchid"))+#scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"))
p2 <- compareInteractions(chat_object, show.legend = F, group = c("AML", "HC"), measure = "weight")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("mediumseagreen", "darkorchid"))+#scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"))

p <- p1+p2

p
```

```{r}
rankNet(chat_object, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1,2), measure = "weight", stacked = F, do.stat = T)
pathways <- rankNet(chat_object, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1,2), measure = "weight", stacked = T, do.stat = T)
pathways
pathways <- pathways$data
pathways <- filter(pathways, pvalues < 0.05)

diff.pathways <- unique(pathways$name)

p <- ggplot(pathways, aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name, fill = group))+
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.5)+
  theme_bw()+scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("mediumseagreen", "darkorchid"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))+
  ylab("Pathway")+xlab("Relative signalling strength")

p
```
